sentences.en: A comprehensive Times investigation reveals that in much of the United States,
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一项全面调查显示，在美国大部分地区，

sentences.en: Americans are pumping out groundwater at alarming rates.
sentences.zh: 美国人正以惊人的速度抽取地下水。

sentences.en: And that this essential source of water for much of the country has reached a critical point.
sentences.zh: 而这种对该国大部分地区至关重要的水源已经到了临界点。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Christopher Flavel goes to the state at the forefront of this crisis and looks at one especially controversial idea to address it.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事克里斯托弗·弗拉维尔将前往这场危机的最前线，并审视一个极具争议的应对方案。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月1日，星期五。

sentences.en: So Chris, tell me about this groundwater crisis that you and our colleagues spent months reporting on.
sentences.zh: 那么克里斯，跟我说说你和我们的同事花了几个月时间报道的这场地下水危机吧。

sentences.en: So almost every part of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 几乎美国的每个地方

sentences.en: relies on groundwater for drinking, for farming, for basically fueling modern society.
sentences.zh: 都依赖地下水来饮用、耕种，基本上是维持现代社会的运转。

sentences.en: And that water has built up deep underground over thousands, in many cases, over millions of years in aquifers.
sentences.zh: 这些水在地下深处的含水层中积聚了数千年，在许多情况下甚至是数百万年。

sentences.en: And it's pumped up through wells.
sentences.zh: 它是通过水井抽上来的。

sentences.en: But what's important is that water isn't just replaced by rain.
sentences.zh: 但重要的是，这些水并不仅仅靠雨水补充。

sentences.en: Even hurricanes like the one in Florida this week won't be enough to replenish them.
sentences.zh: 即使是像本周佛罗里达州那样的飓风，也不足以补充它们。

sentences.en: Once that water is pumped out, in many cases, it's effectively gone.
sentences.zh: 一旦这些水被抽干，在很多情况下，它就彻底消失了。

sentences.en: So what we did is something that no one else has done, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我们做了一件真正没人做过的事。

sentences.en: We built a comprehensive database using data we could find all around the country, trying to get the best picture possible to see what the health of American aquifers is.
sentences.zh: 我们利用在全国各地能找到的数据建立了一个综合数据库，试图尽可能全面地了解美国含水层的健康状况。

sentences.en: How much water are we using?
sentences.zh: 我们用了多少水？

sentences.en: How much is left?
sentences.zh: 还剩下多少？

sentences.en: What are the consequences?
sentences.zh: 后果是什么？

sentences.en: And what we found is that in much of the country, almost everywhere in the country, there's a problem with pumping out groundwater too fast at a rate that means in many places,
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在该国大部分地区，几乎到处都存在地下水抽取过快的问题，这意味着在许多地方，

sentences.en: we're at risk of running out.
sentences.zh: 我们面临着水资源枯竭的风险。

sentences.en: And if that happened, it would fundamentally change those places.
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况发生，将会从根本上改变这些地方。

sentences.en: And not just in the West, but across the U.S., places like Maryland and Kansas and Arkansas and New York and Minnesota, places you don't think of as having water problems that are
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是在西部，而是在全美范围内，像马里兰州、堪萨斯州、阿肯色州、纽约州和明尼苏达州这些你认为不会有水资源问题的地区，

sentences.en: actually quite at risk.
sentences.zh: 实际上也面临着相当大的风险。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: of trying to figure out how to respond to it, and that's Arizona.
sentences.zh: 试图找出应对之策，那就是亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: Arizona is limiting new construction around Phoenix as the state's water supply continues to dwindle.
sentences.zh: 随着该州供水持续减少，亚利桑那州正在限制凤凰城周边的新建项目。

sentences.en: State officials say there isn't enough groundwater for housing construction that has already been approved.
sentences.zh: 州政府官员表示，现有的地下水不足以支持已经获批的住房建设。

sentences.en: This is now a reality check.
sentences.zh: 这现在是一个现实的警钟。

sentences.en: This is people in Arizona finally saying, you know what?
sentences.zh: 这是亚利桑那州的人们终于在说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: You can't live without water and we're running out of our water.
sentences.zh: 没有水你就无法生存，而我们的水快用完了。

sentences.en: Exhibit A in that crisis is the recent decision at the beginning of June when the governor,
sentences.zh: 这场危机的典型案例是6月初州长做出的最新决定，

sentences.en: Katie Hobbs, announced.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·霍布斯宣布。

sentences.en: Today, I'm directing the Arizona Department of Water Resources to publish the Phoenix Active
sentences.zh: 今天，我指示亚利桑那州水资源部发布凤凰城活跃

sentences.en: Management Area Groundwater Model.
sentences.zh: 管理区地下水模型。

sentences.en: That the amount of groundwater underneath Maricopa County isn't enough to support all the homes that have already been approved for construction.
sentences.zh: 马里科帕县地下的地下水量不足以支持所有已经获批建设的房屋。

sentences.en: If we do nothing, we could face a 4% shortfall in groundwater supplies over the next
sentences.zh: 如果我们什么都不做，未来100年内我们可能会面临4%的地下水供应缺口。

sentences.en: 100 years.
And they said any developers that want approval to build new subdivisions have to find some other source of water aside from groundwater.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，任何想要获得新开发项目审批的开发商都必须找到除地下水以外的其他水源。

sentences.en: That's why, as required by law, we will pause approvals of new assured water supply determinations that rely on pumping groundwater.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，根据法律要求，我们将暂停审批依赖抽取地下水的新用水保证方案。

sentences.en: Which is just a real jolt to a system built on rapid and really endless growth.
sentences.zh: 这对一个建立在快速且无休止增长基础上的系统来说，真是一个巨大的冲击。

sentences.en: And it could mean a deep shift in the way people live and work in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着亚利桑那州人们的生活和工作方式将发生深刻转变。

sentences.en: Like, what exactly do you mean?
sentences.zh: 比如，你具体是指什么？

sentences.en: Like, not having enough water to actually drink and bathe?
sentences.zh: 比如没有足够的水来喝和洗澡？

sentences.en: Yeah, having enough water to prepare your food, to bathe, to wash your clothes, to water your lawn.
sentences.zh: 是的，没有足够的水来准备食物、洗澡、洗衣服、浇灌草坪。

sentences.en: You know, if you spend time in Arizona, it's a real land of bounty, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你在亚利桑那州待过，那真是一片富饶之地，对吧？

sentences.en: People aren't living lives where they have to ration anything.
sentences.zh: 人们的生活不需要配给任何东西。

sentences.en: But this would begin to shift Arizona into a place where there just isn't enough of this fundamental component of life.
sentences.zh: 但这将开始使亚利桑那州变成一个缺乏这种基本生命要素的地方。

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like the beginning of the end for growth in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来像是亚利桑那州增长的终结。

sentences.en: Yeah, and if you think about what Arizona is, this is a real shift.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你想想亚利桑那州是什么，这确实是一个真正的转变。

sentences.en: Growth is an underpinning of Arizona's economy and identity.
sentences.zh: 增长是亚利桑那州经济和身份的基石。

sentences.en: And the state's been able to attract people from all over the country with the promise, really, of, you know, bounty in the desert.
sentences.zh: 该州一直能够吸引全国各地的人们，凭借的正是沙漠中富饶的承诺。

sentences.en: And that could begin to change.
sentences.zh: 而这可能开始改变。

sentences.en: But if you go to Phoenix and the expanding suburbs around Phoenix, people don't seem especially worried about it.
sentences.zh: 但如果你去凤凰城及其周边不断扩张的郊区，人们似乎并不特别担心。

sentences.en: They still seem pretty bullish about the future.
sentences.zh: 他们对未来似乎仍然相当乐观。

sentences.en: Give me your sense.
sentences.zh: 说说你的感受。

sentences.en: How do you describe Buckeye to people who don't live there?
sentences.zh: 你如何向不住在那里的人描述巴克艾？

sentences.en: You don't have to shovel sunshine, ever.
sentences.zh: 你永远不需要铲阳光。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: So take, for example, a fast-growing town, city, really, just west of downtown Phoenix, called Buckeye.
sentences.zh: 以一个快速发展的城镇，或者说城市为例，它就在凤凰城市中心以西，叫巴克艾。

sentences.en: It's not unlike a place you can see anywhere in the country.
sentences.zh: 它和你在全国任何地方看到的地方没什么两样。

sentences.en: There's strip malls and houses.
sentences.zh: 到处都是商业街和房子。

sentences.en: You wouldn't know you were in a desert to drive through Buckeye.
sentences.zh: 开车穿过巴克艾，你根本不知道自己身处沙漠。

sentences.en: Buckeye grew up very fast in the past 20 years, from like 8,000 people to over 100,000 people right now.
sentences.zh: 巴克艾在过去20年里发展非常迅速，从大约8,000人增加到现在的超过10万人。

sentences.en: And so...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: I spoke to the head of Buckeye's water department, Terry Lowe, and other city officials.
sentences.zh: 我采访了巴克艾水务部门负责人特里·洛和其他城市官员。

sentences.en: They've already been told at the start of this year that there isn't enough groundwater beneath Buckeye to support new developments.
sentences.zh: 今年年初他们就已经被告知，巴克艾地下的地下水不足以支持新的开发项目。

sentences.en: That's not a secret at this point, but it doesn't seem to be having any drag on sort of optimism in the town.
sentences.zh: 这一点现在已经不是秘密了，但这似乎并没有对镇上的乐观情绪产生任何拖累。

sentences.en: And if you want to go see the ocean, it's only about four or five hours away.
sentences.zh: 如果你想去看海，开车只需要四五个小时。

sentences.en: And if you want to go skiing, you can go...
sentences.zh: 如果你想去滑雪，你可以去……

sentences.en: And if you did, you can ski.
sentences.zh: 如果你想的话，你可以滑雪。

sentences.en: You can be in the desert in one minute and skiing in the next and be back in the same day, right?
sentences.zh: 你可以在一分钟内身处沙漠，下一分钟就在滑雪，并且在同一天回来，对吧？

sentences.en: And the result is they're still talking about how to grow.
sentences.zh: 结果就是他们还在讨论如何发展。

sentences.en: If you haven't lived here, you haven't done a little bit of research, you would think that water is not available and is a challenge
sentences.zh: 如果你没住在这里，没做过一点研究，你会认为水资源不可用，是一个挑战，

sentences.en: and we're going to run out or that type of thing.
sentences.zh: 而且我们快要用完了，诸如此类。

sentences.en: We're not in any way, shape, or form close to any of that.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不是、以任何形式或方式接近那种境地。

sentences.en: So their debate is not whether to grow or whether they can maintain their quality of life.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的争论不是是否要增长，也不是他们能否维持生活质量。

sentences.en: It's where to find the water to support that growth.
sentences.zh: 而是去哪里寻找水源来支持这种增长。

sentences.en: There's water here.
sentences.zh: 这里有水。

sentences.en: It's just, it's not how much water, it's how much do you want to pay for it?
sentences.zh: 只是，不是水有多少的问题，而是你愿意为它付多少钱的问题？

sentences.en: Because the easy water was spoken for 100 years ago, and now it's the more challenging water that's going to have a cost associated with it.
sentences.zh: 因为容易获取的水在100年前就已经被预订了，现在更具挑战性的水源将伴随着成本。

sentences.en: Okay, so Arizona is in this water crisis.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以亚利桑那州正处于这场水危机中。

sentences.en: Much of the state has been told they can't grow anymore.
sentences.zh: 该州大部分地区已被告知不能再增长了。

sentences.en: And yet these people in these suburbs are still talking about growth.
sentences.zh: 然而这些郊区的人们仍在谈论增长。

sentences.en: How do they reconcile that?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何调和这一点的？

sentences.en: Well, remember, they've been told there's not enough groundwater, but they haven't been told they can't grow.
sentences.zh: 嗯，记住，他们被告知地下水不足，但并没有被告知不能增长。

sentences.en: The state has said the groundwater it has now in many key areas can't support more growth.
sentences.zh: 州政府表示，目前在许多关键地区拥有的地下水无法支持更多的增长。

sentences.en: But if they can find new sources of water, there's nothing stopping them from growing.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们能找到新的水源，就没有什么能阻止他们增长。

sentences.en: And what I found from talking to people in the Phoenix area is they think they can do that.
sentences.zh: 我从与凤凰城地区人们的交谈中发现，他们认为自己可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: They feel like this is a problem that they can solve.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这是一个他们可以解决的问题。

sentences.en: But, I mean, how do you find more water?
sentences.zh: 但是，我的意思是，你如何找到更多的水？

sentences.en: Well, that's the question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: And knowing that communities all over Arizona will need more water, last year, Arizona, realizing the trouble it was facing, set up a new program where they set aside money,
sentences.zh: 而且考虑到亚利桑那州各地的社区都需要更多的水，去年，亚利桑那州意识到自己面临的困境，设立了一个新项目，拨出了一笔钱，

sentences.en: a lot of money, a billion dollars, and hired new staff to try to answer that question, where to find the water.
sentences.zh: 一大笔钱，十亿美元，并聘请了新员工来试图回答这个问题：去哪里寻找水源。

sentences.en: And the term of art is water augmentation.
sentences.zh: 这个专业术语叫“水资源增补”。

sentences.en: And there's one idea they're looking at.
sentences.zh: 他们正在研究一个想法。

sentences.en: It's desalination.
sentences.zh: 那就是海水淡化。

sentences.en: Desalination.
sentences.zh: 海水淡化。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Desalination sounds like you take salt out of ocean water?
sentences.zh: 海水淡化听起来像是你从海水中去除盐分？

sentences.en: Very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: So, obviously, the problem here is not that there's not enough water in the world.
sentences.zh: 显然，这里的问题不是世界上没有足够的水。

sentences.en: Oceans cover, what, two-thirds of the Earth's surface.
sentences.zh: 海洋覆盖了地球表面的三分之二。

sentences.en: It's that there's not enough fresh, drinkable water.
sentences.zh: 问题是没有足够的淡水、可饮用水。

sentences.en: So, desalination is taking the resource that we have an abundance of and turning it into the thing that's scarce.
sentences.zh: 所以，海水淡化就是把我们拥有丰富资源的物质转化为稀缺的东西。

sentences.en: And how they do that is you push that water through a membrane.
sentences.zh: 他们的方法是把水通过一层膜。

sentences.en: It's kind of a filter at really high pressure.
sentences.zh: 这是一种在高压下工作的过滤器。

sentences.en: And the filter strips out the salt.
sentences.zh: 过滤器会滤掉盐分。

sentences.en: And you're left with perfectly drinkable water, which, in theory, if it comes from the ocean,
sentences.zh: 剩下的就是完全可饮用的水，理论上，如果它来自海洋，

sentences.en: means you've got, if not an infinite supply, then certainly enough water to answer the challenges in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 意味着你拥有了，如果不是无限的供应，那么肯定有足够的水来应对亚利桑那州的挑战。

sentences.en: How much of an established thing is this, this desalination?
sentences.zh: 海水淡化这种东西有多成熟？

sentences.en: So, this is actually widely used.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这已经被广泛使用了。

sentences.en: There are several desalination plants in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国已经有几家海水淡化厂了，

sentences.en: already, many of them in California and Texas.
sentences.zh: 其中许多在加利福尼亚州和德克萨斯州。

sentences.en: In the Middle East, Persian Gulf countries.
sentences.zh: 在中东，波斯湾国家。

sentences.en: In Israel, it's widely used.
sentences.zh: 在以色列，它被广泛使用。

sentences.en: This is not a new technology.
sentences.zh: 这不是一项新技术。

sentences.en: I think what's changing is, as climate change makes more and more places water scarce, more people are saying, wait, can that be our solution as well?
sentences.zh: 我认为正在改变的是，随着气候变化使越来越多的地方变得缺水，更多的人在说，等等，这能不能也成为我们的解决方案？

sentences.en: And now Arizona is in that camp.

sentences.en: So, I drove the path it would take.
sentences.zh: 所以我开车沿着它将要经过的路径走了一遍。

sentences.en: And the first place you come to, once you cross the border into Arizona, is the Organ Pipe Cactus National Monument, which is a UNESCO site.
sentences.zh: 当你跨过边境进入亚利桑那州后，你到达的第一个地方是管风琴仙人掌国家纪念区，这是一个联合国教科文组织遗址。

sentences.en: And it's federal land preserved for its natural significance.
sentences.zh: 它是为了其自然重要性而保护的联邦土地。

sentences.en: And people don't understand when they say, oh, it's just a desert, it's just a desert.
sentences.zh: 人们在说“哦，这只是沙漠，这只是沙漠”时并不了解。

sentences.en: Well, it's not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它不是。

sentences.en: It's a very lush desert.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常茂盛的沙漠。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I spent time there with two local environmentalists,
sentences.zh: 我和两位当地的环保人士在那里待了一段时间，

sentences.en: Miche Lozano and Lorraine Eiler, and they took me around this really indescribably beautiful and rich landscape.
sentences.zh: 米歇·洛萨诺和洛林·艾勒，他们带我参观了这片难以形容的美丽而丰富的景观。

sentences.en: What does it look like, Chris?
sentences.zh: 它看起来是什么样的，克里斯？

sentences.en: Well, I say welcome to Quito, Quito.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我说欢迎来到基多，基多。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I had never even heard of it.
sentences.zh: 我之前甚至都没听说过这个地方。

sentences.en: This is, I'm so glad we're here.
sentences.zh: 这地方……我很高兴我们能来这儿。

sentences.en: It's filled with these gigantic cactuses, the namesake organ pipe cactuses and saguaro cactuses.
sentences.zh: 这里到处都是巨大的仙人掌，也就是所谓的管风琴仙人掌和巨人柱仙人掌。

sentences.en: They tower over the landscape.
sentences.zh: 它们高耸在景观之上。

sentences.en: They're almost like cartoons, vaguely humanoid, gigantic cactuses.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来几乎就像卡通片里的东西，隐约带着人形，巨大的仙人掌。

sentences.en: And then there's the color, right?
sentences.zh: 还有这里的色彩，对吧？

sentences.en: In addition to the cactuses, every plant seemed to be flowering at the same time.
sentences.zh: 除了仙人掌，所有的植物似乎都在同时开花。

sentences.en: And it was unbelievable, the array of bright reds and yellows and oranges.
sentences.zh: 那景象令人难以置信，明亮的红色、黄色和橙色交织在一起。

sentences.en: It was the exact opposite of what I thought the desert would be.
sentences.zh: 这和我以为的沙漠景象截然相反。

sentences.en: And there was also not an inch of open space.
sentences.zh: 而且这里连一寸空地都没有。

sentences.en: Everything was packed tightly together.
sentences.zh: 所有东西都挤得密不透风。

sentences.en: So that could be one of the biggest challenges facing the project, what it would cost in terms of carving a path, the width of multiple freeways through this landscape.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是该项目面临的最大挑战之一，即要在这种地貌上开辟一条相当于多条高速公路宽度的道路，这需要付出多大的代价。

sentences.en: And then, in addition to the impact on the land and the wildlife, there's also the impact on the Native Americans who have roots in this area, the Tohono O'odham people.
sentences.zh: 此外，除了对土地和野生动物的影响，还有对在这片土地上有根基的美国原住民——托霍诺奥哈姆人（Tohono O'odham）的影响。

sentences.en: My great-great-grandparents are buried there, and other relatives, which was at one time a huge community.
sentences.zh: 我的曾祖父母和其他亲戚都葬在那里，那里曾经是一个庞大的社区。

sentences.en: And so, yes, it has a lot of significance to us.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这对我们来说意义重大。

sentences.en: It's a place where we still have our ceremonies.
sentences.zh: 那是一个我们至今仍会举行仪式的地方。

sentences.en: We hold it in very high esteem.
sentences.zh: 我们对它怀有极高的敬意。

sentences.en: You know, we consider it a sacred place.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们视其为圣地。

sentences.en: Even after the national parks have taken it over, we still go there for religious purposes.
sentences.zh: 即使在国家公园接管之后，我们仍然会为了宗教目的去那里。

sentences.en: And I should say, IDE said in their presentation to Arizona officials that they would go around the wildlife areas and minimize the impact.
sentences.zh: 我得说，IDE在向亚利桑那州官员提交的方案中表示，他们会绕过野生动物保护区，尽量减少影响。

sentences.en: It's not clear to me from being there how that would work.
sentences.zh: 但我在现场时，并不清楚这该如何实现。

sentences.en: It seems like the only way to run this pipeline, to transport water to Phoenix, is to cut a really significant hole through this national monument.
sentences.zh: 看起来要运行这条输水管道，将水输送到凤凰城，唯一的办法就是在国家纪念区中间挖开一个巨大的缺口。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's an open question whether, I guess, you know, the federal government will allow what sounds like would be a significant consequence to this national monument.
sentences.zh: 所以，联邦政府是否会允许这种对国家纪念区造成严重后果的行为，还是个未知数。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And then, as you follow the path of the proposed pipeline north, beyond the national monument, there are communities that would almost certainly be impacted.
sentences.zh: 而且，当你沿着拟建的管道路径向北，越过国家纪念区，那里还有一些几乎肯定会受到影响的社区。

sentences.en: Anything you guys recommend I try and see while I'm in town?
sentences.zh: 你们有什么推荐我在这儿看看的地方吗？

sentences.en: Somewhere to eat?
sentences.zh: 有什么吃饭的地方吗？

sentences.en: Where would you eat if you were there?
sentences.zh: 如果你们在这儿，会去哪儿吃？

sentences.en: First recommendation would be go early.
sentences.zh: 第一个建议是早点去。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: How close is that early?
sentences.zh: “早点”具体是多早？

sentences.en: I went to one town called Ajo, which is a beautiful little community in the desert with small homes and a beautiful laid-out garden in the middle of town.
sentences.zh: 我去过一个叫阿霍（Ajo）的小镇，那是沙漠中一个美丽的小社区，有着小巧的房屋和镇中心布局精美的花园。

sentences.en: It's really a jewel of a place.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个瑰宝般的地方。

sentences.en: The pipeline would either go through or skirt this town.
sentences.zh: 输水管道要么会穿过这个小镇，要么会从旁边绕过。

sentences.en: It's unclear what the effect would be.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚会产生什么影响。

sentences.en: But when you talk to community advocates about it, they're worried.
sentences.zh: 但当你和社区倡导者谈论这件事时，他们感到很担忧。

sentences.en: I talked to Aaron Cooper.
sentences.zh: 我采访了亚伦·库珀（Aaron Cooper）。

sentences.en: He's the head of the International Sonoran Desert Alliance.
sentences.zh: 他是国际索诺兰沙漠联盟（International Sonoran Desert Alliance）的负责人。

sentences.en: An advocacy group.
sentences.zh: 这是一个倡导组织。

sentences.en: And he was concerned.
sentences.zh: 他对此表示担忧。

sentences.en: But the history, there's a history of eviction in this community.
sentences.zh: 因为这个社区有着被驱逐的历史。

sentences.en: There's a history of disenfranchisement.
sentences.zh: 有着被剥夺权利的历史。

sentences.en: He was referring to Ajo's history as a mining town, a town that really exists for the purpose of mining copper and how people who live in Ajo have been pushed around at times
sentences.zh: 他指的是阿霍作为矿业小镇的历史，这个小镇的存在本质上就是为了开采铜矿，以及阿霍的居民在过去是如何被随意摆布的，

sentences.en: and had their land confiscated to suit the whims of big companies.
sentences.zh: 他们的土地被没收以满足大公司的私欲。

sentences.en: So if the company were to try to take this land for the right-of-way through the domain, through the county, there would be a history that it was playing into, I guess,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果公司试图为了通过该领域、通过该县的通行权而征用这片土地，我想，这会触及一段历史，

sentences.en: like sort of a painful history.
sentences.zh: 就像一段痛苦的历史。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's hard to say if those fears would come true.
sentences.zh: 很难说这些担忧是否会成真。

sentences.en: Maybe the pipeline could go around Ajo.
sentences.zh: 也许管道可以绕过阿霍。

sentences.en: But what does seem clear is the pipeline might not be welcomed with open arms in the places it would pass through.
sentences.zh: 但显而易见的是，管道所经过的地方可能并不会张开双臂欢迎它。

sentences.en: And that could represent another obstacle that Arizona has to think about when it's deciding what to do with this idea.
sentences.zh: 这可能代表了亚利桑那州在决定如何处理这个想法时必须考虑的另一个障碍。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But let's assume for the sake of argument that the pipeline clears those hurdles and it gets built.
sentences.zh: 但我们假设一下，如果管道克服了这些障碍并最终建成。

sentences.en: For most of the people in Arizona who are concentrated around Phoenix, is there just pure upside?
sentences.zh: 对于亚利桑那州大多数集中在凤凰城周边的人来说，这是否纯粹是利好？

sentences.en: Well, we come now to the main problem for people in Arizona, which is coSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在我们谈到了亚利桑那州人民面临的主要问题，那就是成本。

sentences.en: Even if this desalination plant and pipeline can get built, the question then is, what does it mean for a state where an affordable cost of living is a big part of the draw?
sentences.zh: 即使这个海水淡化厂和管道能够建成，问题在于，对于一个以负担得起的生活成本为主要吸引力的州来说，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: A lot of people who move to Arizona come from places like California or New York, and maybe they're fleeing a high cost of living.
sentences.zh: 许多搬到亚利桑那州的人来自加利福尼亚或纽约等地，他们可能正是为了逃避高昂的生活成本。

sentences.en: So all of a sudden, you've got a situation where the cost of water is going up a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，你面临的情况是水费将大幅上涨。

sentences.en: Some estimates are the price of water can be as much as 10 times higher.
sentences.zh: 据估计，水价可能会高出10倍之多。

sentences.en: So a big increase to the cost of living in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 这对亚利桑那州的生活成本来说是一个巨大的增长。

sentences.en: At this point, you're looking at a financial burden, which raises the question of if water is available.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，你面临的是经济负担，这引发了一个问题：如果水是可用的，

sentences.en: But for some people, too expensive.
sentences.zh: 但对某些人来说太贵了，那又会怎样？

sentences.en: What would that mean for growth?
sentences.zh: 这对增长意味着什么？

sentences.en: How would that affect the appeal of Arizona as this sort of affordable paradise in the sun?
sentences.zh: 这会如何影响亚利桑那州作为这种阳光下负担得起的“天堂”的吸引力？

sentences.en: Okay, so this is pretty hard, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，这确实很难，对吧？

sentences.en: There are upsides, but also some pretty serious downsides to this thing.
sentences.zh: 这事儿有好处，但也有一些非常严重的坏处。

sentences.en: So how does this decision get made?
sentences.zh: 那么这个决定是如何做出的呢？

sentences.en: Like, who decides for the state of Arizona whether they want to go for it?
sentences.zh: 比如，谁来为亚利桑那州决定他们是否要推进这个项目？

sentences.en: Well, it turns out that decision falls really on the shoulders of one person.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实证明，这个决定实际上落在一个人的肩上。

sentences.en: So I found that guy and asked him what he thought.
sentences.zh: 所以我找到了那个人，问了他的想法。

sentences.en: After the break, that guy.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，就是那个人。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》（The Reframers），这是一个关于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在夜店用黑胶唱片当DJ的年代，每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍贵的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、临时搭建的博物馆，里面陈列着精美的50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘云娜（Wynna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《连接》（Connections）谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试着捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky）。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《拼字游戏》（Spelling Bee）和《字母盒》（Letterboxd）。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”（promesthesia）的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的。

sentences.en: Like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Chris, you said that there's really one guy at the heart of this decision about whether Arizona moves forward with this plan.
sentences.zh: 所以，克里斯，你说亚利桑那州是否推进这个计划，核心其实在于一个人。

sentences.en: Tell me how he's thinking about this.
sentences.zh: 告诉我他是怎么想的。

sentences.en: So this person is Chuck Podolak, and he's the head of WIFA, the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority.
sentences.zh: 这个人是查克·波多拉克（Chuck Podolak），他是水利基础设施金融管理局（WIFA）的负责人。

sentences.en: That's the body that was given a billion dollars to help Arizona find and get new water.
sentences.zh: 该机构获得了十亿美元的资金，旨在帮助亚利桑那州寻找并获取新的水源。

sentences.en: And he's not deciding for Mexico if this is a good deal for Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他不是在替墨西哥决定这对墨西哥是否是一笔好交易。

sentences.en: He's not deciding for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他也不是在替美国政府决定是否应该允许管道越过边境，穿过联邦土地。

sentences.en: government whether or not there should be a pipeline that's allowed to cross the border, go through federal land.
sentences.zh: 他的工作是弄清楚这笔交易对亚利桑那州是否有益，然后与WIFA的董事会成员一起决定亚利桑那州是否应该为此投入资金。

sentences.en: His job is to figure out whether this deal is good for Arizona, and then decide, along with the board members at WIFA, if Arizona should spend money on this.
sentences.zh: 我们应该在这里设置吗？

sentences.en: Should we set up here?
sentences.zh: 你说这是合适的地方吗？

sentences.en: Is this the right spot you said?
sentences.zh: 是的，太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's great.
sentences.zh: 这对你有用吗？

sentences.en: Is that working for you?
sentences.zh: 是的，非常好。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's very good.
sentences.zh: 他邀请我到他的办公室，谈论他如何试图决定这个项目是否是增加和寻找该州新水源的正确方式，或者说是正确方式之一。

sentences.en: And he invited me into his office to talk about how he's trying to decide if this project is the right way or one of the right ways to augment and find new water for the state.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，作为机构的WIFA和你作为局长，在这里似乎肩负着巨大的责任。

sentences.en: To simplify it, it does seem as though WIFA as an agency and you as a director have enormous responsibility here.
sentences.zh: 你被授权花费巨额资金，而且赌注非常高。

sentences.en: You're authorized to spend a huge amount of money, and the stakes are so high.
sentences.zh: 这让人望而生畏吗？

sentences.en: Is it daunting?
sentences.zh: 这是一种负担吗？

sentences.en: Is it a burden?
sentences.zh: 这令人兴奋吗？

sentences.en: Is it exciting?
sentences.zh: 在构建这个决定如何增加亚利桑那州供水的过程中，你的心态是什么？

sentences.en: What's your state of mind building this process of deciding how to augment Arizona's water supply?
sentences.zh: 是的，我想这确实有点令人望而生畏。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it is a bit daunting.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了一些挑战以及他是如何看待这些挑战的。

sentences.en: And we walked through some of the challenges and how he's looking at them.
sentences.zh: WIFA只有在人们愿意买单的情况下才能运作。

sentences.en: WIFA only works if people are willing to pay.
sentences.zh: 他的评估似乎围绕着我们谈到的一些挑战，主要是围绕成本。

sentences.en: His assessment seems to revolve around some of the challenges we talked about, and primarily around the coSt.
sentences.zh: 要完成这样一个大型项目，你必须获得政治上的支持。

sentences.en: To make a large project like that, you have to have political buy-in.
sentences.zh: 那不是一个仅仅……的决定。

sentences.en: That's not a decision that's only...
sentences.zh: 他似乎是否考虑了环境问题，无论是在墨西哥还是在管道将经过的路线沿线？

sentences.en: And does he seem to be taking into consideration the environmental concerns, both in Mexico and along the route the pipeline would take?
sentences.zh: 他并没有过多地考虑墨西哥和亚利桑那州的环境问题。

sentences.en: He's not as much taking into account the environmental concerns, both in Mexico and Arizona.
sentences.zh: 这其实不是他的工作。

sentences.en: It's not really his job.
sentences.zh: 但这些潜在的环境成本可能会在墨西哥和华盛顿特区的考量中发挥作用。

sentences.en: But those potential environmental costs could play a role in Mexico and in D.C.'s calculation.
sentences.zh: 如果我向董事会推荐一个我们觉得没有政治稳定性、没有获得支持的项目，那是不负责任的，

sentences.en: It would be irresponsible for me to bring to the board a recommendation for a project that we didn't feel comfortable, had the political stability, that had the buy-in,
sentences.zh: 从长远来看。

sentences.en: the long term.
sentences.zh: 这意味着边境两侧都要有利益。

sentences.en: And that means benefits on both sides of the border.
sentences.zh: 所以，要让他支持这个计划，他说他需要感觉到它能得到两国的批准。

sentences.en: So for him to back the plan, he said he needs to feel like it can get approval from both countries.
sentences.zh: 但他听起来比你想象的要自信得多。

sentences.en: But he sounded more confident than you might think.
sentences.zh: 你认为该如何看待这件事的疯狂程度？

sentences.en: What might you recommend as the way to think about how crazy this is?
sentences.zh: 疯狂到永远不会发生？

sentences.en: Crazy so it will never happen?
sentences.zh: 还是说很疯狂，但这并不是真正的障碍？

sentences.en: Or like crazy, but that's not really a barrier?
sentences.zh: 在完成之前，它看起来会是疯狂而雄心勃勃的。

sentences.en: It will seem crazy and ambitious until it's complete.
sentences.zh: 他确实把这个想法放在了亚利桑那州更广阔的背景下，并指出，如果你回顾亚利桑那州的历史，

sentences.en: He really put this idea in the broader context of Arizona and made the point that if you look throughout Arizona's history,
sentences.zh: 这个州是建立在不断的供水项目推进之上的，这些项目在最初提出时，听起来都很疯狂，直到它们被建成。

sentences.en: the state has been built on this constant progression of water projects that when they first get proposed, sound insane until they get built.
sentences.zh: 我们有一条人工河流，从哈瓦苏湖（Lake Havasu）向山上流向图森（Tucson），全长几百英里。

sentences.en: We have an artificial river that runs uphill from Lake Havasu to Tucson, several hundred miles.
sentences.zh: 那是一个疯狂、大胆的想法，但它已经完成了，现在我们几乎不再去想它了。

sentences.en: That is a crazy, audacious idea, but it's done and now we barely give it a second thought.
sentences.zh: 他提到了一个经典的例子，即现代亚利桑那州的基石，也就是所谓的“中央亚利桑那项目”（Central Arizona Project）。

sentences.en: And he mentioned the classic example, the sort of foundation of modern Arizona, is something called the Central Arizona Project.
sentences.zh: 这是一条将科罗拉多河的水输送到凤凰城的引水渠。

sentences.en: It's an aqueduct that carries water from the Colorado River to Phoenix.
sentences.zh: 它是凤凰城惊人增长的源泉。

sentences.en: And it's the source of Phoenix's amazing growth.
sentences.zh: 他的观点是，这并不是亚利桑那州第一次面临需要更多水的情况，他们正在考虑看似疯狂的想法。

sentences.en: His point was, this isn't the first time Arizona has faced a situation where they need more water and they're looking at seemingly crazy ideas.
sentences.zh: 但当你深入了解时，它们并非不可能实现的想法。

sentences.en: But when you get down to it, they're not impossible ideas.
sentences.zh: 它们非常昂贵。

sentences.en: They're very expensive.
sentences.zh: 它们需要大量的协调、大量的资金，在某些地方可能还会带来环境问题。

sentences.en: They require a lot of coordination, a lot of money, possibly environmental problems in some places.
sentences.zh: 但核心想法是，如果替代方案是亚利桑那州停止增长，那么，也许投入这些资金是值得的。

sentences.en: But the idea is, if the alternative is Arizona doesn't grow, well, maybe it's worth putting in that money.
sentences.zh: 并没有一个机构或一个人说，我们需要增长更多或更少。

sentences.en: There's not a body or a person who says, we need to grow more or less.
sentences.zh: 人们想要来到亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: There's people wanting to come to Arizona.
sentences.zh: 人们来到亚利桑那州有很多原因。

sentences.en: There's a lot of reasons why people come to Arizona.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经商的好地方。

sentences.en: It's an attractive place to do business.
sentences.zh: 这是一个居住的好地方。

sentences.en: It's an attractive place to live.
sentences.zh: 和查克交谈时，你会感觉到他认为亚利桑那州是一个只要你愿意想得足够大，障碍——即使是像水这样的大障碍——也能被克服的地方。

sentences.en: You get the feeling talking to Chuck that he sees Arizona as a place where obstacles, even big obstacles like water, can be overcome if you're just willing to think big enough.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想这确实有点令人望而生畏。

sentences.en: And so it's just like this sort of foundational optimism that allows the West to persevere in the face of a really hostile climate that's only becoming more hostile.
sentences.zh: 正是这种基础性的乐观精神，让西方能够在面对日益恶劣的气候时，依然能够坚持下去。

sentences.en: And so to his mind, this latest idea for a desal pipeline project was just one more iteration of that ideal that keeps driving the American WeSt.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，这个最新的海水淡化管道项目，不过是推动美国西部不断前行的那种理想的又一次体现。

sentences.en: We don't have the luxury of looking at Arizona from the outside and saying, gee, that's really rough.
sentences.zh: 我们没有闲暇站在局外去评价亚利桑那州，说那里的情况真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: Like we have to say, yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 我们必须承认，是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: It's hard.
sentences.zh: 这很艰难。

sentences.en: But what are we going to do next?
sentences.zh: 但我们接下来该怎么办？

sentences.en: How are we going to deliver water?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何输送水源？

sentences.en: How are we going to continue to serve customers and citizens of the state?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何继续为本州的客户和公民提供服务？

sentences.en: These are tough issues.
sentences.zh: 这些都是棘手的问题。

sentences.en: There's no clear way out.
sentences.zh: 目前没有明确的解决出路。

sentences.en: It's going to be expensive.
sentences.zh: 这会很昂贵。

sentences.en: It's going to be hard.
sentences.zh: 这会很困难。

sentences.en: But we can't throw our hands up and just say it's too hard.
sentences.zh: 但我们不能两手一摊，只说这太难了。

sentences.en: We have to figure out a way.
sentences.zh: 我们必须想出办法。

sentences.en: He's basically saying we've always done this and we're going to do it again.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，我们一直以来都是这么做的，以后也会继续这样做。

sentences.en: We've bent the environment to our will, all in service of growth.
sentences.zh: 我们为了增长，一直都在强行改变环境以顺应我们的意志。

sentences.en: But, of course, to keep growing and growing into infinity, even if we technically can, raises the question of whether they should.
sentences.zh: 但是，当然，即便技术上可行，这种无止境的增长是否真的应该继续，这引发了质疑。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like, does he think about that question?
sentences.zh: 比如，他思考过这个问题吗？

sentences.en: Not can we build it, but should we?
sentences.zh: 不是我们能不能造，而是我们应不应该造？

sentences.en: You know, it's a great question, and I asked him that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个很好的问题，我也问过他。

sentences.en: What's your response to somebody who says, Arizona, you shouldn't have built that much.
sentences.zh: 对于那些说“亚利桑那州，你们不该建设这么多”的人，你有什么回应？

sentences.en: Are they wrong?
sentences.zh: 他们错了吗？

sentences.en: I would say we're not ignorant.
sentences.zh: 我会说我们并非无知。

sentences.en: We're just up for the challenge.
sentences.zh: 我们只是勇于迎接挑战。

sentences.en: It's not that we don't know it's dry.
sentences.zh: 并不是我们不知道这里干旱。

sentences.en: It's not that we don't know we've got challenges.
sentences.zh: 也不是我们不知道自己面临挑战。

sentences.en: It's that we have no option but to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 而是我们别无选择，只能想办法解决。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He's basically saying the state is doing this.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，州政府正在采取行动。

sentences.en: We're not engaging on this question of top-down, deciding whether to stop growing or not.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有参与关于自上而下决定是否停止增长的讨论。

sentences.en: We're adapting.
sentences.zh: 我们正在适应。

sentences.en: We're figuring it out.
sentences.zh: 我们正在寻找对策。

sentences.en: And that's the same sentiment I heard from other officials in Arizona, too.
sentences.zh: 我在亚利桑那州的其他官员那里也听到了同样的观点。

sentences.en: So what that means is the decision about whether and when Arizona stops growing is left to people voting with their feet,
sentences.zh: 这意味着，关于亚利桑那州是否以及何时停止增长的决定，留给了那些用脚投票的人，

sentences.en: considering the cost of water and deciding whether to move to Arizona or not.
sentences.zh: 他们会权衡水价，然后决定是否搬到亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: And so far, that demand isn't going away.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这种需求并没有消失。

sentences.en: And the thing that grabs me with this pipeline idea is that, yes, on the one hand, it's a perfect continuation of that history of Arizona, that ethos of Arizona.
sentences.zh: 这个管道构想最吸引我的一点是，一方面，它确实是亚利桑那州历史和精神的完美延续。

sentences.en: On the other hand, in the face of climate change, it's maybe appropriate to at least ask, well,
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，面对气候变化，或许至少应该问问，

sentences.en: for how long can you keep on building your way and engineering your way out of reality?
sentences.zh: 你们还能通过建设和工程手段逃避现实多久？

sentences.en: So in the short term, if this pipeline is built, it means that the water will flow, growth will continue, despite the costs, environmental and otherwise.
sentences.zh: 所以短期来看，如果这条管道建成，意味着水流将持续，增长将继续，尽管要付出环境及其他方面的代价。

sentences.en: And if you can afford it, you can come, right?
sentences.zh: 只要你负担得起，你就可以来，对吧？

sentences.en: So again, a huge water infrastructure project is moving the goalposts of what's possible
sentences.zh: 所以，又一个巨大的水利基础设施项目正在改变“可能性”的界限，

sentences.en: and forestalling really an existential reckoning about whether more and more people should continue coming to live in a desert.
sentences.zh: 并推迟了关于“是否应该有越来越多的人继续在沙漠中生活”这一生存问题的清算。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's why Arizona is really at the forefront of dealing with this groundwater crisis.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么亚利桑那州确实处于应对地下水危机的最前沿。

sentences.en: And they're trying to engineer their way out of it.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图通过工程手段来解决问题。

sentences.en: And in a sense, that's the history of humanity inhabiting the earth and extreme areas in the earth and building their way around those limits and those constraints.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这就是人类在地球上居住、在极端地区生存，并绕过这些限制和约束进行建设的历史。

sentences.en: That's sort of what we do.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们所做的。

sentences.en: The question here is, can we do it forever?
sentences.zh: 这里的问题是，我们能永远这样做吗？

sentences.en: And will climate change impose some sort of new limit that means you've got to shift away from building your way out of those problems and instead say, well,
sentences.zh: 气候变化是否会施加某种新的限制，意味着你必须放弃通过工程手段解决问题，转而思考，

sentences.en: maybe there's some areas where it doesn't make sense to keep on building.
sentences.zh: 也许有些地区确实不适合继续开发。

sentences.en: So, bottom line, is this going to happen?
sentences.zh: 那么，归根结底，这会实现吗？

sentences.en: You know, I'd take Chuck at his word.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我选择相信查克的话。

sentences.en: He said that probably at some point, some version of this plan will happen.
sentences.zh: 他说过，可能在某个时候，这个计划的某个版本会实现。

sentences.en: Some version of getting desalinated water from Mexico is likely because that demand for now in Arizona isn't going away.
sentences.zh: 从墨西哥获取淡化水的某种方案很可能会实现，因为亚利桑那州目前的需求不会消失。

sentences.en: And for the moment, there's no other formal options that have been presented.
sentences.zh: 而且目前还没有提出其他正式的方案。

sentences.en: There's a saying in water circles that water flows uphill to money, and this would be one more case of water flowing uphill to money.
sentences.zh: 水利界有句谚语：水往高处流，钱往高处走，这将是“水往钱处流”的又一个案例。

sentences.en: So, it wouldn't surprise me if some version happens.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果某个版本真的实现了，我也不会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: But what does it look like?
sentences.zh: 但它会是什么样呢？

sentences.en: What does it cost?
sentences.zh: 成本是多少？

sentences.en: Who suffers?
sentences.zh: 谁会受苦？

sentences.en: Will it work?
sentences.zh: 它会奏效吗？

sentences.en: And for how long?
sentences.zh: 能维持多久？

sentences.en: Chris, thank you.
sentences.zh: 克里斯，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，萨布丽娜。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 周四，南非约翰内斯堡的一栋建筑发生火灾，造成至少74人死亡，其中包括至少12名儿童，另有数十人受伤。

sentences.en: Officials said the fire occurred in a five-story building that was known to be a popular site for squatters in a city plagued by a severe lack of affordable housing.
sentences.zh: 官员称，火灾发生在一栋五层建筑内，该市严重缺乏经济适用房，这栋楼是众所周知的非法居住点。

sentences.en: The fire was one of the deadliest in South Africa's history.
sentences.zh: 这是南非历史上最致命的火灾之一。

sentences.en: And, in an unusual move, Justice Clarence Thomas included a statement in his annual financial disclosure form defending luxury trips, flights on a private jet,
sentences.zh: 此外，在一项不同寻常的举动中，大法官克拉伦斯·托马斯在他的年度财务披露表中加入了一份声明，为豪华旅行、私人飞机飞行，

sentences.en: and a real estate transaction with Texas billionaire Harlan Crowe.
sentences.zh: 以及与德克萨斯州亿万富翁哈兰·克劳的房地产交易进行了辩护。

sentences.en: Thomas wrote that trips on non-commercial flights had been advised due to increased security risk following the leak of the draft opinion in the Dobbs case.
sentences.zh: 托马斯写道，在多布斯案意见草案泄露后，由于安全风险增加，他被建议乘坐非商业航班。

sentences.en: He also argued that his past filings that had omitted luxury trips with Crowe were proper, writing that he had, quote, adhered to the then-existing judicial regulations.
sentences.zh: 他还辩称，他过去未申报与克劳的豪华旅行的备案是合规的，并写道他“遵守了当时现行的司法法规”。

sentences.en: He did, however, acknowledge errors in past reports in which he failed to disclose personal bank accounts and his wife's life insurance, writing that the omission was inadvertent.
sentences.zh: 不过，他确实承认了过去报告中的错误，即未能披露个人银行账户和妻子的人寿保险，并写道这些遗漏是无意的。

sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.zh: 他们有过敏或食物敏感吗？
